title: Tomato Superstar
styleLine: Pixar-style 3D animation, soft cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, no text, no captions, no subtitles.
beats: hook: he steps into the spotlight and refuses to be salad
turn: he announces he will become ketchup, by choice
payoff: inside the blender jar, the lid lowers, he is at peace

shots.speaker: tomato-superstar
shots.line: Doston, aaj main salad nahi banunga. Aaj main kuch bada karunga.
shots.sfx: a stage spotlight clunk, a tiny footstep squeak

shots.camera: low wide shot past the vegetables
shots.speaker: tomato-superstar
shots.line: Main ketchup banunga. Apni marzi se. Koi mujhe rok nahi sakta.
shots.sfx: a small gasp from the vegetables, a blender motor starting off screen

shots.camera: close-up, slow push-in, lit from below
shots.speaker: tomato-superstar
shots.line: Superstar banne ke liye thoda toot-na padta hai.
shots.sfx: a glass blender lid clicking shut

estimate.quotaUnit: seconds of video generation per month
